wrong.why: Shemaiah records the divisions before the king and other officials, but the verse does not identify him as David's personal scribe.

missing.why: The Hebrew explicitly identifies Zadok as belonging to the sons of Eleazar.
Shubael, represented here by Shebuel, is named among the sons of Amram.
Under the KJV's reading of Beno as a name, he is explicitly listed among Merari's sons through Jaaziah.

note: Hebrew בנו can mean 'his son' rather than the name Beno, so the Beno rows are not definite errors. The owner's Aaron-descendant rulings agree with the chapter's description of the priestly divisions and Aaron as their father in 1CH 24:19.
